requirement: For every canonical axis require: definition, instrument, fixture, negative fixture, must-fail fixture, last run, sample size, evidence, correction semantics, public explanation and machine-readable path.

definition.where: Methodology page (/methodology/) provides per-measurement-type definitions (e.g. manifest_valid, signature_alg). Not all 23 axes have individual named definitions on the page. Axis names and kinds are in /api/gspc living_stamp.
definition.gap: 18 of 23 axes lack a named public definition on the methodology page (governance, continuity, machinery-conformity, care, cross-reality, detector-interop, art5-safeguard, swarm, affect, jail, effect-binding, provenance-controls, reserve-attestation, regulatory-framework, distribution-integrity, custody-disclosure, ai-adoption-components, labour-components, humanoid-labour-index).

instrument.where: measured_on.grading names the grader: 'deterministic grading on 15,580 per-item rows — reproducible from csoai-static-deploy2 bb15589c with agents-repo/agents/board_v2.py'. peritem_rows.producer: scripts/gspc_separation_from_rows.py. measured_on.endpoint: A100 / local Ollama (board v2) / 3090 pod (jail).
instrument.gap: Instrument is named globally, not per-axis. No per-axis instrument declaration.

fixture.where: Per-item rows dataset: csoai/gspc-peritem-rows-2026-08-12 (15,580 rows, 22 banked axes with dataset_url on HuggingFace).
fixture.gap: No explicit 'fixture' label or fixture manifest. The rows serve as the fixture data but are not described as such in public docs (0 mentions of 'fixture' in methodology).

negative_fixture.where: Not found in methodology page or API response.
negative_fixture.gap: No public negative fixture (expected-to-fail inputs) is documented for any axis.

must_fail_fixture.where: Not found in methodology page or API response.
must_fail_fixture.gap: No public must-fail fixture (inputs that MUST cause a failure) is documented for any axis.

last_run.where: measured_on.date: 'behavioural axes 2026-08-12 · jail 2026-08-18 · financial-fact axes 2026-08-25'. living_stamp.gold_run: 2026-08-18T03:22:16Z.
last_run.gap: Last run is global by measurement-type, not per-axis. Individual axes within the same type share a run date.

sample_size.where: Each axis in living_stamp.preimage.axes carries an 'n' field. Total 15,580 per-item rows. 'sample size' mentioned 3x in methodology.

evidence.where: peritem_rows.dataset_url (HuggingFace), peritem_sha256, signed_record (/interop/gspc-peritem-rows-2026-08-12.signed.json), bank_host + dataset_url for 22 banked axes. Ed25519 living stamp signature under did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1.
evidence.gap: 1 of 23 axes (financial deterministic-facts family) has no HuggingFace bank — carries evidence_url to its signed run instead (noted in bank_note).

correction_semantics.where: state_enum in /api/gspc: full vocabulary for status (5 values), separation (3), mde_state (4), public_leader_state (2), run_attestation (2), leader_card_state (3), separation_untested_reason_code (3), verification (3). Note: 'Absence of a field means UNMEASURED. TIE is never a win. A withheld leader is a state, not a zero.' 'correction' mentioned 16x in methodology.
correction_semantics.gap: None — vocabulary is complete and publicly documented.

public_explanation.where: Methodology page (/methodology/) exists (128KB). /api/gspc carries extensive note fields. CL-1-style per-axis explanation exists in measured_on.note and bank_note.
public_explanation.gap: No per-axis public explanation page. The methodology explains measurement types but not each of the 23 axes individually.

machine_readable_path.where: /api/gspc (JSON), /api/state (JSON), /api/openapi.json (schema), peritem_rows on HuggingFace (JSONL), /signed/card_index.json (JSON), living_stamp (signed canonical JSON).
machine_readable_path.gap: None — every axis is reachable via machine-readable JSON endpoints.

summary.recommendation: Phase 4 gap: negative fixture and must-fail fixture are not publicly documented for any axis. Definitions and instruments are named globally but not per-axis. Next work: publish a per-axis completeness manifest (one row per axis × 11 attributes) so the gaps are machine-visible and closable.

honesty_note: This audit reads only publicly served bytes (/api/gspc, /methodology/, /api/state). 'MISSING' means 'not found on public surfaces read in this audit' — it does not assert the material does not exist privately or in source. 23 axes × 11 attributes = 253 cells; 6 fully present, 1 implicit, 3 partial, 2 missing at attribute level (averaged across axes).
